description: This file defines a Dart class named 'Category' which models a transaction category with properties like id, name, color, and icon. It includes methods for copying with modifications, converting to/from a map representation for database storage, and a getter for color representation.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: A model class representing a transaction category, including properties and methods for serialization and copying.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of this Category with optional modifications to its fields.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Constructs a Category instance from a map (e.g., from a database record).

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Category instance into a map suitable for database storage.

methods.name: color
methods.description: A getter that returns a Color object based on the stored colorValue.
